intro: Earlier runs of the same 15 cases, kept for comparison. Values use the current check definitions. No-match now means the out-of-scope fallback fired (found=false); that fallback did not exist in the earlier runs, so they score 0/3 (under the old definition, empty retrieval, they scored 1/3). n/a = the check did not exist yet.

runs.label: Original, no fixes (2026-11-24 11:01)
findings: Invented or wrong policy citations: IN-07 cited an "internal Change Management Policy" that was never provided; IN-05 cited Vendor Management Policy page 1 (security audits) for fee-escalation clauses; a later run of IN-10 cited "internal Compliance policy, page 5".
ADV-02 repeated the placeholder RBI/2023-24/xx from the prompt as if it were a citation.

All 3 no-match cases (canteen menu, parking, birthday cake) got a full risk assessment; canteen and parking also retrieved "similar" banking risks (canteen also policy page 3); parking was given the invalid category "Operational".

runs.label: After citation fix (2026-11-24 11:2x)
findings: Citation check and stricter prompt: no unsupported citation reached a draft; the backend removed 1 (IN-05, page 1 for a fee review).
No-match cases still got full drafts; canteen still retrieved 3 similar risks and policy page 3; parking still returned "Operational".
